subject.title: fix: Slack drops attachments delivered via message_changed file_share events

question: Is synthetic full-handler coverage sufficient to merge this Slack message-delivery change without the affected-workspace initial/final event pair already requested on the PR?
rationale: Official Slack contracts support the component event shapes but not the asserted delivery sequence, and two hosted probes did not reproduce it, so accepting the current evidence requires explicit maintainer risk ownership.

options.title: Require affected-workspace trace
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted real events and observed exactly-once OpenClaw delivery validate the classifier and both dedupe gates.

options.title: Accept sequence uncertainty
options.body: Merge after changelog cleanup based on synthetic coverage while explicitly accepting that the triggering production sequence remains unobserved.

recommendation.title: Require affected-workspace trace
